thesis: The enforcement gap is not missing gates, it is gates that are armed, correct, and red while the surface that consumes them is read by nobody. Three scheduled tasks have never executed (0x41303). The pre-push hook blocks every push at gate 1, so gates 2-11 have never been exercised against a real push. The census gate the repo cites as proof of enforcement is the one instrument the hook deliberately does not run.

enforcement_points.critical_finding: The hook calls the patrol WITHOUT --collect. AGENTS.md:27 states the --collect deep check is 'kept out of the default pre-push path because it needs the venv' - and the hook's own .venv interpreter is what runs the call, so the stated reason does not hold. Without --collect the gate reads the carrier's own number and cannot see the drift it was built to catch.
